name: Ghost Hair Comb
summary: Madame Eva sends Ghost Hair Comb to Blind Mary at her lonely home on Duskwood’s outskirts. The comb stirs grief, then yields ghostly hair for Eva to spin into thread.

sections.title: A Tragic Vanity
sections.body: Madame Eva of Darkshire sends Ghost Hair Comb to Blind Mary, who lives in a lonely, dilapidated dwelling on Duskwood’s outskirts. At the sight of it, the ghost recoils in horror. She must face that she is no longer the lovely living woman she remembers. Grief-stricken, Mary thrusts the comb away, leaving strands of her ghostly hair tangled in its teeth.

sections.title: Spun from Sorrow
sections.body: Madame Eva receives Ghost Hair Comb back in Darkshire, its teeth still holding Blind Mary’s spectral hair. Eva gathers the delicate strands and spins them into Ghost Hair Thread. The thread is a mystical material used to stitch and bind occult creations in Duskwood’s shadowy realm.

faq.q: What is the Ghost Hair Comb?
faq.answer: Madame Eva of Darkshire sends Ghost Hair Comb to the spirit Blind Mary. The comb catches strands of Mary’s spectral hair, which Eva spins into Ghost Hair Thread.

faq.q: Why does Blind Mary scream and reject the comb?
aliases: why did mary throw the comb
faq.answer: Blind Mary rejects the comb because it reminds her of the mortal beauty she has lost. It forces her to face that she is now a terrifying spectral monstrosity, not the lovely woman she remembers from life.
Madame Eva, the diviner and hedge-mage who lives in Darkshire, asks for Ghost Hair Comb back so she can gather the trapped ghost hair.

faq.q: What is the ghost hair used for?
faq.answer: Madame Eva spins the ghostly strands into Ghost Hair Thread, an unusual material used for occult rituals and crafting in Duskwood.

angles.text: As a tailor, you can see the uncanny textile in the strands caught in the comb. They are spun from spectral sorrow, not sheep’s wool or silkworms.
As a priest, you can hear the mortal vanity and deep spiritual torment in Mary’s anguished rejection of the comb, familiar among Duskwood’s restless dead.
